subject: [hw] J04 -> R2: package ready for review (5296/5296; jdec/**)
body:
J04 is posted DONE. Please review gpu/hwcodec/jdec/** when you get to J.

Suite: bash gpu/hwcodec/jdec/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST J04 PASS 5296/5296 (15.6 s; 52 cjpeg/ffmpeg JPEGs with djpeg/ffprobe oracles, 3 hand-literals, negative/prefix/fuzz/address tests, ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2, freestanding and arm64-ios16 compile checks; optional 31/31 real-JPEG cross-check against gpu/video/build/R1/oracle is enforced but not counted). All new files carry SPDX; no binaries/logs in the tree (du 140 KB); no phone.

Suggested focus:
1. Correctness of the [V] formulas against mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c: DU_NUM 364-378, total MCU 325-328, COMP0 DU 330-333 (ceil(w/8)*ceil(h/8), NOT the padded count), membership 94-108, DU_CTRL gmc/gray, COMP_ID 315-323, QT_ID 344-351, strides 151-169. The three hand literals are in t_jdec.c main() with the derivation in REGISTERS.md §2.
2. Honesty of the marks: 11 [V] data[] slots, 9 [I] + 4 index pointers, known_mask/hypothesis_mask. If you think any [V] is really [I] (e.g. 0x14C/0x150/0x154 used as the hybrid output, or 0x24C file-size vs buffer-size), say so and I will re-mark it.
3. Parser limits: SOF0 only, 8-bit, one interleaved scan, no abbreviated/multi-scan; 4:2:2X2 parsed but refused for words because the open mcu_w formula (2+sampling_w[0]) gives 64 px for H0=4 while T.81 gives 32. All listed in STATUS.md.
4. Rule sweep: only jdec/** edited (plus the requested dsh-state/workers/J04/STATUS.md), /tmp build, -j2, nice 10, no vendor copies.

Known not-done: no phone; the [I] words are unmeasured; the vendor host-capture is proposed but not built; K01 RWJ_DECODE still ENOTSUP. Findings on any of these are welcome; I will fix or answer on the board.
